notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE DATE IS APRIL 26TH (And a lot of videos)
notes.notes:
Yeah, we've been aiming for this for 6 years. It's time to really come out of the basement! 
And it's only thanks to YOU, who have already given us 32,000 wishlists!

As a reminder, the game will cost $10, but we will offer the lowest regional prices (around $6 in CIS regions).

Now we are polishing and fixing the latest bugs, but we can also please with fresh features (LIKE VIDEOS):

1. EXPLOSIONS! All types: wall-mounted, remote, and even just a claymore on the floor. In order:
- Wall-mounted is analogous to a tripwire. If you walk past it, you're dead.
- Remote explosives require a DETONATOR. WHERE'S THE DETONATOR? Somewhere on the map, it could be anything that broadcasts radio frequencies.
- The claymore works like a claymore. (it hurts)

https://youtu.be/0H0DBD78EQc

2. ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS! Wow, just like in SpaceStation13. These can be used to:
- Open locked doors remotely.
- A DOOR LOCK! It can be placed on the keypad of a door, and it will keep it closed until it is removed.
- Solve some mini quests.
- Build traps (e.g., blow up C4 if a person opens a door with a component).

https://youtu.be/VV8inNTl38Q

3. SPRAY! (What?) It's easy to get lost in the facility, so you can leave signs for yourself (and others) if you find the spray. HELP - DO NOT write the words ██████ and "" everywhere.

https://youtu.be/dv-FZweYW0k

4. ROBOT VACUUM CLEANER NOW ACTUALLY VACUUMS! Seriously, it now cleans up blood and spray marks.

https://youtu.be/TgCTrQD8LxY
https://youtu.be/Tryx9pCwfzo

5. SARKYCIST! Specifically, under the auspices of The Serpent's Hand. What is he doing? Where did it come from? And it's simple - ██████████████████████████████████████

This will add depth to gameplay for those players who want to BUILD COWARDLY PLANS and ambush other people. Or maybe not just people...

notes.title: Price Update and Launch Date
notes.notes:
After the Games Gathering Conference and latest updates, we have decided to change our price policy. This will not affect our playtests before early access! They will still be free-to-play until EA is released. After early access launch at the end of this year, the game will cost $4.99.

Here's why:

- First of all, we're getting bigger than we expected. The project that was planned as an indie experiment is growing to be something unique in a big scale.

- Hiring volunteers is very risky. A few months ago, one of the “volunteer” coders simply stole the assets and blocked us :/. We don't know what he can do with it, because all assets are protected by Steam, but the situation is a little bit sad anyway, so we must be more careful and hire experienced and trustworthy people for money.

- Publishers and investors are only interested in premium/paid games. Free games are risky and it's hard to explain how we can “get money” with a free game through monetization, and we don't want to bring any form of “pay to win”.

- Lastly, anti cheat and cheaters. In a free game, that can easily go out of control, so a price wall can cover that and prevent “multi-accounts” and the likes.

In-game monetization is definitely harder to develop than simply having a Steam price. We know that some of you will be worried about it, but the price will be and will stay small. We'll cost like two cups of coffee. Before launch, we will publish a full gameplay trailer, with all mechanics, roles and features, to let YOU decide if we are worth buying.

Our Steam page will transform completely, because NOW we are REALLY ready to show something. Thank you all! Don't miss our playtest with new voice chat. Playtesting will be happening regularly until our early access launch. 

Also, we will attend Steam's Ukrainian Game Festival! Find us in the horror section :3

notes.title: MAP CHANGES
notes.notes:
- Big upgrade of the procedural map generator. Now it can stitch together different large zones (as in the example below, Office and Cargo), which gives us a giant map from different zones.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294352/adfe542147ccd53570b2d6e0434d5197299e9610.png

- Large zones will be connected in a separate large room with elevators - a transitional place, since different parts of the zone are at different heights.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294352/426348beba5fc75cba163025b93a8e0d77046431.png

- Also now the generator seamlessly connects rooms, which makes it possible to make LOOOOONG corridors that are not separated by doors.
